evidence.title: Happy Hues - Curated colors in context.

name: Happy Hues
summary: Palette inspiration site that shows 17 curated color palettes applied to a live example page you can click through.
description: Curated color palettes shown in context: picking a palette updates every element of the example site — background, headline, buttons, illustration — so you can judge the shades before using them. Clicking an element copies its hex code, and short sections explain color terminology (hue, tint, shade, tone, value, saturation) and the psychology of color.
contains: 17 curated palettes applied to a live example page
click any element to copy its hex code
sections on color terminology and the psychology of color
